layout_summary: A minimalist meme composition set on a solid white canvas, featuring a central cut-out kitten surrounded symmetrically by four flower bouquet cut-outs in the corners. Bold sans-serif black text sits centered above and below the central subject to form a classic top-and-bottom meme caption.

alignment_axes: Top headline and bottom punchline are centered around the x=50.5% vertical axis
Central kitten cutout is centered along the x=50.0% vertical axis
Top-left red rose box and bottom-left lily bouquet align along left margin x=3.0%–3.5%
Top-right orchid bouquet and bottom-right sunflower bouquet align along right margin x=96.5%–97.5%
whitespace: 12.5% empty white margin above the top text
8.0% vertical gap between top text baseline and top-left bouquet
6.5% vertical gap between kitten's tail tip and bottom punchline text
7.0% empty white margin below bottom bouquets

scene.subject: An orange-and-cream tabby kitten lying flat on its back with eyes squinted shut, chin tilted upward, paws tucked near its sides, and a dark-tipped tail extending downward.
scene.composition: Full-body isolated cutout positioned vertically down the center of the canvas, flanked symmetrically on left and right by four floral arrangements.
scene.camera: High-angle overhead flat-lay shot, sharp focus across the fur.
scene.lighting: Soft, even indoor ambient light with gentle natural shading under the chin and belly.

elements.description: Round black hatbox filled with red roses and baby's breath, tied with a red satin ribbon bow.
Bouquet of magenta purple orchids wrapped in pink and gold paper with a black branded ribbon.
Bouquet of pink lilies, peach roses, and white blooms wrapped in white paper with a pink ribbon.
Bouquet of bright yellow sunflowers and eucalyptus leaves wrapped in cream paper with a black ribbon.

why_it_works: High-contrast black geometric type on pure white delivers instant meme readability on social feeds.
Four corner flower cutouts frame the expressive central kitten without visual clutter or overlapping edges.
Clean product photography doubles organically as comedic props while subtly displaying brand packaging.
